vgabios-0.8a-unemu.1-src

Corresponding source for two files that the unemupc98 emulator project builds
from the unemu fork of the LGPL VGABIOS, the video BIOS used by Bochs and
QEMU, changed to run on an 80286 (repository unemu-org/vgabios):

  vgabios-std.bin       flake output std, 32,768 bytes
    SHA-256 7570ef9c66fd386450bb35fd2b6c91aba6f8ec69a565a1d7747e6e6716ea5389
  int10-probe-1200.img  flake output int10-probe, 1,228,800 bytes
    SHA-256 21b9dd1db3068bb73f3fde16058578368719f98b6d4335f45ec6681eb47beb58

Contents

  vgabios/  the fork at release tag v0.8a-unemu.1, revision
            8e154f04c5b1c8029d1ac3a3827f077352d579b7: the tree Nix builds
            both files from, with two parts left out. The five
            VGABIOS-lgpl-latest*.bin files are upstream's prebuilt,
            unmodified 0.8a images, whose source this archive does not
            carry. .beads/hooks/ holds a developer's issue-tracker git
            hooks. Neither is used to build the files above. Nothing else
            is changed. README.unemu.md lists the changes from upstream
            VGABIOS 0.8a.
  NOTICE    this file.

  LGPL-2.1-or-later. The vgabios.c header grants the GNU Lesser General

  contributors to the fork.

Rebuild

  With Nix (flakes enabled), from the vgabios directory; flake.nix and
  flake.lock pin the toolchain:

    nix build .#std            # result/vgabios-std.bin
    nix build .#int10-probe    # result/int10-probe-1200.img

  Both results must match the SHA-256 values above.
